thread:
Devon: Heads up — we've got a bunch of /v2/ requests getting routed to the default model instead of the canary variant since ~09:10UTC. Attach logs below.
Aj: can you paste a snippet from the decision logs? thinking it's a header match ordering issue or our prefix/regex clash
Devon: here's the relevant decision-log lines (sanitized):
```
request_id=abc123 route_candidates=[v2-canary, v2-stable, default] matched_rule=v2-stable reason=header_mismatch header=x-env value=canary not_found
request_id=abc124 route_candidates=[v2-canary, v2-stable, default] matched_rule=default reason=prefix_fallback
```
Maria: ugh. looks like some requests have `x-env: CANARY` uppercase and our header match is case-sensitive. Also we recently added a regex route that could be shadowing the prefix match.
Nina: @Devon can you grep for `header` vs `prefix` match counts in the last 12h? i.e. how often does header_mismatch show up vs prefix_fallback
Devon: running now, quick output: header_mismatch=412, prefix_fallback=97, default_match=68 (all in last 12h)
Tom: that ratio suggests header normalization is the main issue. We should either make header matching case-insensitive or normalize at the gateway. Also we need better observability: when a rule evaluation happens we want a compact trace showing the rule evaluation order for each request.
Aj: agreed. today we only sample decision traces at 0.1% for volume reasons. For urgent debugging can we temporarily bump sampling for route:v2 to 100% for 10 minutes? then we can inspect full eval traces for failed requests.
Maria: yeah, but let's be surgical — sampling by tag (route:v2) + failure reason=header_mismatch would be ideal. Is there an API to change sampling rules? I remember a debug endpoint.
Devon: there is. use admin API: `curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/v1/routing/sampling -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"filter":"route:v2 AND reason:header_mismatch","rate":1.0,"duration_seconds":600}'`
That returns a job id.
Aj: doing it now. job=job-772.
<sre-bot>: Sampling rule job-772 created by Aj — filter=route:v2 AND reason:header_mismatch rate=100% duration=600s
Nina: awesome. once we have traces we should add a column in the Console request table linking directly to the rule-eval trace. Right now you have to copy request id and open a separate trace UI.
Tom: UX + infra follow-up: in the decision log we should also emit `normalized_headers` (lowercased) so rule reasons can show the pre-match state. Minimal change and very helpful.
Maria: agree. short-term: enable header normalization at the ingress layer (lowercase keys, trim whitespace) and we'll roll a tiny gateway patch. Long-term: add a config flag `match.header.case_insensitive=true` with migration docs.
Devon: after enabling sampling we found 95% of header_mismatch cases were `X-Env: CANARY` or `x-env: canary\t` (trailing tab!). shows we need trimming too.
Aj: patching ingress now. patch includes: `headers = map(lowercase, trim(values))` in the route matcher. will deploy to staging then canary.
Devon: quick test on staging looks good — requests with mixed-case headers matched canary route. will promote to canary cluster in 15m.
<sre-bot>: Deploy started by Aj: gateway-ingress v1.8.3 -> canary cluster
Nina: follow-up items for console: 1) surface sampling toggle in route detail page 2) show last N evaluation steps inline 3) add link from request row to rule-eval trace
Tom: I'll file the tickets and assign. low-effort quick wins first.
`/issues create` summary: "Route decision trace: surface eval steps + sampling toggle" assigned Tom, priority=P2
Devon: after patch is live, observed routed_to=canary for ~99.2% of test requests. leaving the sampling rule on for another 5m then will revert.
Aj: re-run the log counts after 30m and post here. if numbers hold we can close this incident. thanks all :thumbsup:
Devon: post-check: header_mismatch=3, prefix_fallback=12, default_match=4 in next 30m window. still some anomalies but ~98% fixed. I'll open a small follow-up to handle trimming of header lists vs single values.
Maria: nice one. also let's add a small note in the runbook that says "when routing surprises happen: increase route sampling, check normalized_headers in traces, look for trailing whitespace/case differences"
Tom: done — runbook updated and linked in the incident channel.
<sre-bot>: Sampling rule job-772 expired after 600s
Devon: closing the thread unless someone needs more data. thanks everyone!
